title: Ralph Langner: Cracking Stuxnet, a 21st-century cyber weapon
summary: In an 11-minute TED talk, Ralph Langner explains how his team reverse-engineered the Stuxnet worm and worked out that it targeted industrial control systems, with a covert state origin. It is a compact look at cyber-forensics.
why: HN points people to it as the short, accessible account of how Stuxnet was dissected, usually when Stuxnet or state-sponsored malware comes up.

quote.text: The Stuxnet TED talk [0] was really interesting
